description: Angular component for a chat interface in a web application. Manages conversation messages, sends user questions via REST API, and optionally listens to WebSocket stream for incremental token updates.

classes.name: ChatComponent
classes.description: Angular component that handles displaying chat messages, managing form submissions, and integrating with API and WebSocket services for real-time communication.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes ChatComponent, subscribes to WebSocket message stream to handle token streaming and end of stream.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Unsubscribes from WebSocket message stream on component destruction to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles user submitting a question. Sends question via WebSocket if connected, otherwise via REST. Manages message state and pending states.

methods.name: prepareAssistantPending
methods.description: Adds a placeholder message for assistant's pending response.

methods.name: hasPendingAssistant
methods.description: Checks if there's an ongoing assistant response pending completion.

methods.name: appendStreamingToken
methods.description: Appends streaming token to the pending assistant message for incremental display.

methods.name: finalizeStreaming
methods.description: Marks the pending assistant message as completed.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors by logging and displaying error message.

ctags.name: messages
ctags.pattern: /^  messages: Array<{ role: 'user' | 'assistant' | 'system', content: string, pending?: boolean }>/

fields.name: messages: Array<{ role: 'user' | 'assistant' | 'system', content: string, pending?: boolean }>/
